svg.title: HeyPossible reminder automation, drawn
svg.desc: A line drawing of an n8n workflow. A schedule trigger reads a master config sheet and checks whether a date exists. Members and fireside form responses are pulled from Airtable, duplicates are removed, and name mismatches are merged. Slack users and IDs are looked up, emails are checked, people are re-tagged, and Slack reminders go out 72 hours and 24 hours ahead.
